findings.location: Second paragraph after the testimony; explanation of “manifest”
findings.source_quote: The word “manifest” means “to come to view”
findings.suggested_fix: Change “in die gesig kom” to “sigbaar word” (or “in die gesigsveld kom”) to convey “to come to view.”
findings.translation_quote: Die woord “openbaar” beteken “in die gesig kom”
